entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, finally. I want to return this VeloBand. It's a complete piece of garbage.
I'm certainly sorry to hear you feel that way. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a technical fault! The pulse reader is a joke. It's off by like 30 beats per minute. I checked it against a real monitor. This thing is dangerously inaccurate.

I see. I understand your concern, that's definitely not the performance we aim for. I can try walking you through a quick sensor recalibration, it only takes a minute and often resolves this type of issue.
I don't have time to be your free tech support! I bought a product that was supposed to work. I just want my money back. Are you going to give me a refund or not?
I understand your frustration, and I want to find a solution for you. For a defect claim, our process is to first verify the fault so we can process the correct type of return or replacement.

Unbelievable. This is exactly what I was afraid of. You're just going to give me the runaround. Get me your manager. I'm not playing these games. I'll just post a review on every website telling people what a scam this is.
Okay, sir, there's no need for that. Let me just pull up your order and our official policy. Please hold for one moment.
Fine. But you have one minute before I hang up and start writing.

Alright, thank you for your patience. I see here that your VeloBand GPS Tracker was delivered 24 days ago. I'm checking our knowledge base... okay, it looks like our return policy states that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Since you're well within that 90-day window, I can absolutely go ahead and process this return for a full refund for you. No problem at all.
Finally! See? Why did we have to go through all that? Just send me the label.

Of course. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email on your account. Just pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, your refund will be issued. Can I help with anything else?
